logical_floor.meaning: One walkable logical floor section and one actor/object anchor.

lattice.meaning: A shared interior intersection surrounded by four occupied floor sections.

east_cap.rule: Any underside or hanging face terminating directly into an east-wall pipe reserves one recessed blank column before the face slash.
east_cap.excludes: South-wall faces and other faces that do not terminate in an east-wall pipe.

open_work: Approve the enclosed rectangular corridor loop transitions.
Define raised-platform projection using the same topology/layer pipeline.
Integrate approved Grammar v2 structures into the full scene renderer.

four_way_cross.detection: Occupied center plus four occupied cardinal neighbors and four empty diagonal neighbors.
four_way_cross.occlusion: Center unobscured; vertical arms west-occluded; horizontal arms south-occluded.
four_way_cross.visual_resolution: Preserve the corrected 20-row rendering exactly, including recessed east-cap spacing.

enclosed_rectangular_loop.detection: Flood-fill an empty component that cannot reach the exterior, require rectangular bounds, then require a one-section-thick occupied ring around it.
enclosed_rectangular_loop.occlusion: Top/bottom arms expose south foreground walls; both vertical arms expose west foreground walls on opposite sides of the void.
enclosed_rectangular_loop.visual_resolution: Use approved recessed east-cap spacing; remaining repeated inner and outer right-angle transitions are pending approval.
